text:
maria: Heads-up — we need p5 + g5 quotas bumped in eu-west-14 for a new customer org (lagoon-prod). They'll run inference-heavy and occasional long-context training jobs. Initial ask: 8 p5s, 12 g5s across two AZs. Also need ENI, Elastic IPs, and an IPv6 burst pool for NAT fallback. Account: 123456789012. Timeline: 2 weeks to start rolling.
alex: Got it. Which exact p5 flavor are we talking about (p5d vs p5)? Multi-AZ spread? Do we want on-demand ceilings or reserved capacity (Dedicated) request as well?
maria: p5 (p5.48xlarge) standard, on-demand ceilings only for now. Multi-AZ: eu-west-14a/b. We'll revisit Dedicated if we need guaranteed throughput. Please include g5.48x and g5.16x variants in the request since some tests will use smaller GPUs.
samir: Quick cost note — 8x p5.48x + 12x g5.* sustained will be non-trivial. Recommend a staggered ramp (bring up 2-3 instances first) to validate networking and NAT costs :chart_with_upwards_trend:
cloud-ops: Opening quota tickets now. We'll need EC2 Accelerator (p5/g5) quota increases, ENI limit bump, EIP count, and increase to "IPv6 addresses per network interface" / burst pool for natgw fallback. Creating internal ticket INFRA-4873.
cloud-ops: ```
# example commands I'll attach to the AWS case
aws service-quotas request-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-0A12B345 --desired-value 20  # p5 family
aws service-quotas request-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-0CDE6789 --desired-value 30  # g5 family
aws service-quotas request-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-XXXXX --desired-value 500  # ENI
# plus support case with account id & scaling profile
```
deploy-bot: INFRA-4873 created. AWS case 2026-00034567 opened. Assigned to rep Hannah from AWS. ETA: accelerator quotas typically 3-5 business days, ENI/EIP/IPv6 often 1-2 days. I'll post updates here when the case moves.
maria: Also request that AWS enable an IPv6 burst pool (or explicit allowance) for eu-west-14 — we ran into ipv4 exhaustion on last rollout and need natgw fallback to ipv6 to avoid EIP spikes.
alex: We'll need subnet and AZ layout for neteng. I'll coordinate with @raj for CIDR planning and NAT gateway placement. Also add a note to the ticket about expected boot concurrency so AWS can allocate capacity accordingly.
raj: I'll prepare the AMI bake and an infra smoke test (startup script + kernel logs). Once quotas land we'll do a small 4-instance soak + egress stress to validate NAT/route table behaviour.
cloud-ops: AWS asked for expected throughput and vCPU counts. Please provide a short scaling profile (initial target, ramp, burst) so I can append to the support case.
maria: Scaling profile: initial 200 QPS (inference), steady 400 QPS after 7 days, burst up to 800 QPS. Avg sequence length ~512 tokens. We'll attach a CSV with instance counts vs expected qps.
alex: Perfect. I'll update INFRA-4873 with the account ID, scaling profile, AZ distribution, and the AMI IDs once @raj uploads them. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: INFRA-4873 | updated with p5/g5 counts, ENI + EIP + IPv6 request. Next update expected in ~48 hours from AWS support.
maria: Thanks team. Please flag any blockers — especially if AWS asks for region-specific entitlements. I'll pause the customer rollout until quotas confirmed.
